title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator readiness — Batch 27: Mali

administrative_geography.selector_status: existing 19-region entry verified and retained; Bamako remains separate

official_2025_campaign_results.note: Government-reported national campaign totals. Cereal aggregate is not crop-specific; controlled meat and collected milk are not farm-level livestock productivity or price metrics.

programme_targets_2026.note: Programme targets, not observed production or confirmed delivered inputs.

campaign_policy_prices_2026_27.note: Campaign policy/support prices reported from the June 2026 Supreme Council of Agriculture session. Verify grade, formulation, farmer eligibility, availability, delivery and actual farmer-paid price before use in a budget.

market_and_input_context.FAO_july_2026_wholesale_coarse_grain_tre: Prices in monitored markets were generally 10–30 percent below year-earlier levels; Gao and Tombouctou conflict-affected markets remained significantly higher than other regions.

historical_rice_farmgate_price.source: USDA FAS rice supplementary annual update for West Africa

historical_rice_retail_price.source: USDA FAS rice supplementary annual update for West Africa

market_and_input_context.note: FAO price movements do not provide absolute regional input costs. March 2025 rice prices are historical. Retail and wholesale prices must not be used as producer prices.

survey_readiness.title: Agricultural Survey 2023–2024 (Enquête Agricole de Conjoncture, EAC)
survey_readiness.publisher: CPS/SDR, Ministry of Rural Development; catalogue hosted by FAO
survey_readiness.coverage: All regions except Kidal in this round; Bamako district has limited agricultural activity.
limitations: First-stage sample coverage 86 percent; holdings coverage 79.4 percent; second-round response rate 58.3 percent.
Survey delays and security/funding constraints affect coverage; weights and precision must be reviewed.
Public microdata are anonymised and subject to confidentiality and use restrictions.

readiness.crop_data: Partial: official 2025 national campaign cereal/cotton totals and EAC survey source identified; crop-specific region yield distributions not extracted.
readiness.prices: Partial: FAO wholesale price trends, USDA historical rice farmgate/retail prices, and campaign-specific cotton price found; current regional crop farmgate matrix missing.
readiness.inputs: Partial: 2026/27 policy fertilizer support prices and FAO price-change trends found; absolute farmer-paid product costs and crop application rates missing.
readiness.currency: XOF identified; calculator formatting and regression tests pending.

blockers: Extract and quality-check the EAC 2023–2024 crop-cut yield, plot area, input use, labour and livestock tables; document survey weights, sample coverage and Kidal exclusion.
Obtain current crop-specific farmgate prices by region and market; the 2025 rice farmgate price is historical and the 2026 cotton price applies to a specified campaign grade.
Verify the 2026/27 fertilizer support price, product formulation, eligibility, allocation and farmer-paid delivery costs.
Obtain current seed, crop protection, labour, machinery, irrigation, energy and transport costs by region and production system.
Build validated regional crop/livestock enterprise budgets and XOF regression tests before calculator activation.
safeguards: Mali remains not_active and directory_only in the country registry.
The existing 19-region lookup is retained; Bamako remains a separate district, not a 20th region.
Government 2025 cereal aggregate is not split into crop or region estimates.
EAC sample exclusions and coverage limitations are recorded; no unsupported national extrapolation is made.
Historical rice farmgate price and campaign-specific cotton/fertilizer policy prices are not treated as current universal crop/input prices.
No calculator activation, merge to main or production deployment was performed.
next_step: Extract the EAC 2023–2024 regional crop-cut yield and input/labour tables; obtain current farmgate prices and farmer-paid cost schedules; build regional enterprise budgets before activation.
